name: stage7_dense_week_v0_patterned
description: Stage 7 fixture v0 — extractor-pattern-friendly variant. Pair to stage7_dense_week.json. Same characters, same week, same questions; sentences rewritten in the explicit patterns the heuristic extractor recognises ('I am X', 'X is the Y lead', 'X lives in Y', 'X is back on the 17th'). The contrast between the two fixtures isolates one variable: input prose style. If this fixture passes and the natural-language version fails, the gap is extraction, not memory.
